claim.statement: LLM training work must declare the task objective, output schema, evaluation target, and authority boundary before data collection or fine-tuning starts.
claim.evidence_summary: OpenAI model optimization guidance and TRL training method docs support treating task objective and method choice as explicit engineering inputs.
claim.interpretation_notes: This candidate is scoped to AI Engineering governance for LLM trade quality scoring/gating systems. It does not define trading signals, order execution rules, or strategy parameters.

applies_when: Building or auditing LLM training, RAG, MCP, evaluation, or governance for trade quality scoring/gating assistants.
not_applicable_when: The task asks for concrete trading entries, exits, position sizing, account-specific settings, or live order execution.
assumptions: External projects provide project facts and private data; CEK-TA stores only generalized reusable knowledge.
limitations: Candidate requires human or AI audit before conversion to formal reviewed knowledge.

source_refs.evidence_summary: OpenAI frames model optimization as an eval, prompt, fine-tuning, and feedback loop rather than a one-step training action.
TRL documents SFT, DPO, reward modeling, and related post-training tooling, supporting method-boundary classification.

limitations: Sources support the engineering boundary; final formal knowledge should add CEK-TA-specific examples and conflict links.

conflict_audit.resolution_summary: No direct conflict found in current CEK-TA formal knowledge. Candidate is not default guidance.

content_patch_notes: 正式 statement 可写为：Before data collection, SFT, DPO or evaluation design starts, every LLM training effort must declare task objective, output schema, evaluation target, authority boundary, allowed sources and forbidden outputs.
明确 task objective 不得是具体买卖点、仓位、止损止盈或实盘订单动作。
缺少 authority boundary 时，不得进入 training data collection 或 fine-tuning proposal。
boundary_patch_notes: AI Engineering 管理任务目标、schema、eval、authority boundary 和 training method selection。
Trading Engineering 管理交易策略、风险阈值、执行逻辑、K 线信号和实盘交易风控。
不得把训练目标写成具体交易策略优化或实盘收益承诺。

required_followups: 补 eval cases：missing output schema、unclear task objective、training objective implies order execution、research task treated as live gate。
